description: This source file implements the JSONProjectWriter class responsible for generating JSON representations of build targets and settings, including filtering targets, writing JSON output, and invoking scripts post-generation. It is part of a build system, likely Chromium's, for exporting project data.

classes.name: SimpleJSONWriter
classes.description: A helper class for incrementally writing large JSON files to a StringOutputBuffer, supporting nested dictionaries and lists with proper indentation and escaping.

methods.name: GenerateJSON
methods.description: Generates a JSON string representing build settings and targets, sorted and formatted for output.

methods.name: RenderJSON
methods.description: Returns the JSON string generated for given build settings and targets.

methods.name: FilterTargets
methods.description: Filters a list of all targets based on directory filter string and dependencies, ensuring a stable order.

methods.name: RunAndWriteFiles
methods.description: Generates JSON, writes it to a file, and optionally executes a script after writing.
